recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future change to make List.entry.flag repeating should come from a new work-group decision and tracker rather than from this resolved DSTU1 issue.
issue_request: FHIR-5678 was a Published FHIR-core List change request with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification. The final resolution was to change the List entry flag cardinality from repeating to 0..1 and update the definition accordingly.
initial_application: Git commit 304db837a48d21af881357a443d387d3d721848f applied #5678, matching Jira's svn revision 6816 comment. It changed List.entry.flag from 0..* to 0..1, revised the short/definition wording, and removed a second flag from the medication list example.
additional_context: The active source/fhir.ini resource list includes list=List, and the current StructureDefinition source preserves List.entry.flag with max value 1. Current List examples do not show multiple flags on a single entry. A 2020 Zulip thread asked about future multiple flags, but Jira and community searches found no applied/published core reversal of the FHIR-5678 decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current build source already implements the published decision.
